name: Phở gà Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Phở gà Hà Nội (Hanoi Chicken Noodle Soup). A large steaming artisanal ceramic bowl filled with crystal-clear, golden aromatic chicken broth simmering with charred ginger and shallots. Silky soft flat rice noodles topped with succulent slices of free-range yellow-skin chicken (gà ta), tender poached chicken breast and dark meat, garnished with finely sliced kaffir lime leaves (lá chanh), scallions, and cilantro. Served on a dark rustic wooden table with side plates of fresh red chilies, juicy lime wedges, and crisp quẩy (cruller). Soft natural side lighting, delicate steam rising, 8k resolution, editorial food magazine style.

name: Bún thang Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Hanoi Bún thang. A sophisticated ceramic bowl showcasing a colorful mosaic of neatly arranged toppings over fine white rice vermicelli: shredded poached chicken, paper-thin golden fried egg ribbons, julienned giò lụa (Vietnamese pork roll), tender shredded wood ear mushrooms, and pickled daikon radish, topped with a dab of fermented shrimp paste (mắm tôm) and Vietnamese coriander. Crystal-clear hot pork-chicken broth poured around. Rustic dark wooden tabletop, atmospheric lighting, mouth-watering gourmet presentation, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh cuốn Thanh Trì
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Bánh cuốn Thanh Trì (steamed thin rice rolls). Delicate, translucent, paper-thin steamed rice crepes rolled with savory minced pork and wood ear mushrooms, glistening with shallot oil and generously topped with fragrant golden crispy fried shallots (hành phi). Placed on a rustic ceramic plate alongside thick slices of golden chả quế (cinnamon pork pâté). Served with a warm dipping bowl of sweet-savory amber fish sauce with sliced bird's eye chili and fresh herbs (coriander, mint). Warm natural light, rustic wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Nem rán Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Hanoi Crispy Fried Spring Rolls (Nem rán Hà Nội). Golden-brown, ultra-crispy spring rolls with blistered crunchy rice paper skin, sliced diagonally to reveal a juicy, savory filling of seasoned minced pork, shrimp, glass noodles, carrots, and wood ear mushrooms. Resting on a wicker basket lined with green lettuce and fresh herbs. Accompanied by a bowl of amber garlic-chili sweet fish sauce with pickled green papaya flowers. Dark rustic table, warm highlights, 8k resolution.

name: Nộm bò khô Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hanoi Beef Jerky Papaya Salad (Nộm bò khô). A mound of crisp, shredded green papaya and carrot ribbons tossed with dark, chewy, spicy-sweet beef jerky and caramelized beef spleen strips. Topped with a generous shower of crunchy roasted golden peanuts, fresh fragrant kinh giới (Vietnamese balm) and mint leaves, drizzled with tangy sweet-sour vinegar dressing. Artisanal ceramic dish on a rustic dark wooden surface, bright fresh colors, 8k resolution.

name: Cháo sườn sụn Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of traditional Hanoi Pork Cartilage Congee (Cháo sườn sụn Hà Nội). A smooth, velvety, milky-white rice porridge in a rustic stoneware bowl, topped with tender braised crunchy pork cartilage riblets, fluffy golden pork floss (ruốc), freshly ground black pepper, chopped scallions, and golden crispy cruller chunks (quẩy giòn). Steam gently drifting upwards. Set on a dark wooden table, natural cozy morning lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu ếch măng cay
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hanoi Spicy Frog and Bamboo Shoot Hot Pot (Lẩu ếch măng cay). A bubbling central metal hotpot filled with golden, aromatic, spicy-sour broth with red chilies and fresh tomatoes. Beside the pot, an appetizing plate of wok-tossed frog legs golden-fried with crispy turmeric and garlic, accompanied by pickled sour bamboo shoots, fragrant wild betel leaves (lá lốt), tía tô, and a platter of fresh rice vermicelli. Atmospheric restaurant dining setting, rising steam, dark rustic table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún cá cay Hải Phòng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Hai Phong Spicy Fish Noodle Soup (Bún cá cay Hải Phòng). A large ceramic bowl of steaming, rich reddish-orange fish bone broth flavored with tamarind and tomatoes, filled with soft rice vermicelli. Topped with deep-fried golden crispy freshwater fish fillets, chewy fish cakes, crispy fried fish offal (dạ dày cá), and vibrant green elephant ear stems (dọc mùng). Garnished with fresh dill and scallions. Dark wooden tabletop, rising steam, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh đa cua Hải Phòng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Hai Phong Crab Red Noodle Soup (Bánh đa cua Hải Phòng). Distinctive wide, chewy reddish-brown rice noodles in a rich, steaming crab broth. Generously topped with fluffy clumps of savory crab paste (riêu cua), grilled minced pork wrapped in wild betel leaves (chả lá lốt), fish cakes, crispy pork cracklings (tóp mỡ), and fresh water spinach (rau muống). Side plate of lime, chili, and perilla leaves. Rustic dark wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún ngan cháy tỏi
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hanoi Pan-Seared Garlic Duck Vermicelli (Bún ngan cháy tỏi). A sizzling cast-iron platter or artisanal ceramic plate piled with tender, juicy slices of grass duck pan-seared with a crust of ultra-crispy golden sliced garlic cloves and red chili. Served with a bowl of soft rice vermicelli, pickled sour bamboo shoots in chili vinegar, a bowl of rich duck broth with bamboo, and a piquant ginger-garlic fish sauce dip. Rustic wood table, glistening caramelized textures, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm hến Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Huế Baby Clam Rice (Cơm hến Huế). A bowl of fluffy white rice served with seasoned wok-tossed baby river clams (hến xào), crunchy golden pork cracklings (tóp mỡ), roasted peanuts, shredded banana blossoms, mint, starfruit, and taro stems. Served with a bowl of cloudy, savory-sweet hot baby clam broth, fermented shrimp paste (mắm ruốc), and roasted chili jam on a rustic dark wooden table. Soft daylight, authentic Hue imperial culinary style, 8k resolution.

name: Bún hến Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Huế Baby Clam Noodle Soup (Bún hến Huế). Delicate rice vermicelli topped with tiny sauteed river clams, crispy pork rinds, golden roasted peanuts, shredded banana flowers, mint, and toasted sesame rice crackers. Hot fragrant clam broth infused with lemongrass and shrimp paste poured gently into the bowl. A small ceramic dish of spicy red Hue chili paste and lime on the side. Rustic wooden table, steam rising, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh nậm Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Huế Flat Steamed Rice Dumplings (Bánh nậm Huế). Five flat, rectangular dumplings partially unwrapped from dark green banana/dong leaves, revealing silky smooth, semi-translucent white rice dough topped with a rich orange-red filling of finely minced seasoned river shrimp and pork belly. Served with a small ceramic saucer of sweet-savory amber fish sauce with sliced red bird's eye chilies. Dark vintage wooden table, high-end food presentation, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh ram ít Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Huế Bánh ram ít. A platter of traditional Hue dumplings: each piece featuring a snowy, soft, chewy steamed sticky rice dumpling filled with savory minced shrimp and pork, resting elegantly atop a golden-brown, extra-crispy fried sticky rice cake base (ram). Drizzled with bright green scallion oil and orange shrimp floss (tôm cháy). Served with sweet spicy fish sauce on a rustic dark wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh canh cá lóc Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Central Vietnam Snakehead Fish Tapioca Noodle Soup (Bánh canh cá lóc Huế). A steaming rustic earthenware bowl of thick, chewy rice-tapioca noodles in a fragrant, golden-red broth simmered from fish bones and shallot oil. Topped with tender, braised chunks of snakehead fish marinated in turmeric, lemongrass, and fish sauce. Garnished with finely chopped scallions and lots of black pepper. Rising steam, dark wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Tré Bình Định
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Binh Dinh Fermented Pork (Tré Bình Định). Unwrapped from traditional straw bundle packaging, savory fermented pork ear and snout tossed with toasted sesame, fragrant galangal julienne (củ riềng), whole garlic cloves, and fresh bird's eye chilies. Served on a ceramic plate lined with guava leaves, with crunchy garlic cloves, pickled garlic, and fresh herbs. Rustic dark wood tabletop, warm directional lighting, artisanal Vietnamese specialty, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm niêu cá bống kho tiêu
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Claypot Rice with Braised Goby Fish (Cơm niêu cá bống kho tiêu). An open rustic claypot of steaming fragrant white rice with a golden crispy bottom crust, served next to an earthenware pot of caramelized river goby fish simmered in a dark, glossy, peppery sauce with whole green peppercorns, scallions, and red chilies. A side dish of boiled seasonal greens. Dark rustic table, cozy warm evening dining atmosphere, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh xèo tôm nhảy Bình Định
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Quy Nhon Jumping Shrimp Crepes (Bánh xèo tôm nhảy Bình Định). Three small, round, ultra-crisp golden crepes sizzling on a banana leaf platter, each studded with fresh pink river shrimp cooked whole with crispy shells and crunchy bean sprouts. Served with a basket of fresh wild herbs, cucumber ribbons, rice paper for rolling, and a bowl of thick garlic-chili soy bean dipping sauce. Dark rustic wooden table, mouth-watering textures, 8k resolution.

name: Bún mắm nêm Đà Nẵng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Da Nang Vermicelli with Fermented Anchovy Sauce (Bún mắm nêm Đà Nẵng). A large bowl of soft white rice vermicelli topped with crispy golden crackling pork belly slices (heo quay), Da Nang beef sausage (chả bò), boiled tender young jackfruit shreds, crunchy roasted peanuts, and scallion oil. Beside the bowl sits a ceramic dish of pungent, savory-sweet fermented anchovy sauce (mắm nêm) blended with minced pineapple, garlic, and red chili. Dark wooden table, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu gà lá é Đà Lạt
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Dalat Chicken Hotpot with Lemon Basil (Lẩu gà lá é Đà Lạt). A bubbling stainless steel or ceramic hotpot filled with clear, sweet-savory chicken broth, tender braised free-range chicken pieces, and fresh oyster mushrooms. A generous wicker basket filled high with fresh fragrant lá é (lemon basil) and bird's eye chilies. Served with a bowl of soft rice vermicelli and a small saucer of crushed salt, lime, and fresh green chilies. Cozy misty Dalat ambiance, dark wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Bún mắm miền Tây
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Mekong Delta Fermented Fish Noodle Soup (Bún mắm miền Tây). A steaming, rich bowl of dark aromatic broth simmered with linh and sặc fish paste, lemongrass, and eggplant chunks. Generously topped with peeled pink tiger prawns, tender squid rings, crispy roasted pork belly (heo quay), and stuffed bitter melon. Served with a side platter of fresh aquatic herbs (water lily stems, rau đắng, điên điển flowers). Dark rustic wooden table, culinary steam, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh canh cua giò heo
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Saigon Crab and Pork Knuckle Noodle Soup (Bánh canh cua giò heo). A deep ceramic bowl filled with thick, chewy, translucent tapioca noodles in a rich, velvety, glistening orange crab gravy. Generously topped with whole fresh crab meat clusters, a tender braised pork knuckle with gelatinous skin, steamed crab cakes (chả cua), quail eggs, and fresh scallions. Garnished with fried shallots and black pepper. Dark wooden table, steam rising, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm chiên Dương Châu
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Vietnamese Special Fried Rice (Cơm chiên Dương Châu). A ceramic plate of fragrant, golden, glistening fried rice where every grain is separated, wok-tossed with diced Chinese sweet sausage (lạp xưởng), sweet pink shrimp, diced char siu pork, green sweet peas, diced carrots, and scrambled golden egg shreds. Garnished with fresh cucumber slices and cilantro sprigs. Warm restaurant side lighting, rustic wooden table, appetizing 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu mắm miền Tây
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Mekong Delta Fermented Fish Hotpot (Lẩu mắm miền Tây). A central boiling clay hotpot brimming with fragrant, deep umami fish paste broth with tender eggplants and lemongrass stalks. Surrounded by a magnificent feast platter: fresh snakehead fish fillets, whole river prawns, squid, sliced pork belly, and an abundant assortment of Southern water greens (water lily stems, shredded water spinach, yellow sesbania flowers, rau nhút). Dark rustic wood table, rising steam, 8k resolution.

name: Cơm cháy kho quẹt
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Southern Vietnamese Scorched Rice with Caramelized Dip (Cơm cháy kho quẹt). A golden, ultra-crispy, concave disc of toasted scorched rice (cơm cháy đáy nồi) resting on a bamboo tray. Beside it, a steaming small earthenware pot containing thick, bubbling, dark caramel kho quẹt sauce filled with savory dried shrimp, crispy pork lard cubes (tóp mỡ), scallions, and fresh green peppercorns. Accompanied by a platter of vibrant steamed seasonal vegetables (okra, carrot, gourds). Dark wood table, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh mì xíu mại
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Saigon Meatball Baguette (Bánh mì xíu mại). A steaming rustic ceramic bowl filled with plump, tender pork meatballs simmered in a rich, velvety, bright red tomato sauce with melted cheese and chopped scallions. Beside the bowl is a warm, golden-brown, crispy Vietnamese baguette, with crisp crumbs scattered on butcher paper over a dark weathered wooden tabletop. Morning sunlight, rising steam, gourmet editorial style, 8k resolution.

name: Cháo lòng miền Nam
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Southern Style Pork Offal Congee (Cháo lòng miền Nam). A large stoneware bowl filled with steaming, savory, brownish-hued rice porridge simmered with pork bone broth and roasted rice. Topped with an abundant assortment of cleanly prepared pork delicacies: sliced golden fried blood sausage (dồi chiên sả), pork liver, heart, tongue, and crispy pork cracklings. Garnished with julienned ginger, scallions, and crushed black pepper. Dark wooden table, natural steam, 8k resolution.

name: Bò né trứng ốp la
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Sizzling Beef Skillet (Bò né trứng ốp la). A cow-shaped cast iron skillet smoking hot, sizzling with tender marinated beef steaks in rich garlic-butter gravy, two sunny-side-up eggs with bright runny orange yolks, a slab of savory liver pâté, and creamy laughing cow cheese. Served with a warm crusty baguette, a small dish of cucumber and tomato salad, and a saucer of chili soy sauce. Dark wooden table, dramatic sizzling steam, 8k resolution.

name: Ốc hương xào bơ tỏi
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Saigon Sweet Snails Sautéed in Garlic Butter (Ốc hương xào bơ tỏi). A ceramic serving plate piled high with glossy, speckled spiral sweet snails (ốc hương) coated in an aromatic, golden, velvety sauce of melted butter, abundant crispy fried minced garlic bits, and red chili slivers. Garnished with fresh rau răm (Vietnamese coriander). Accompanied by a warm crusty bread roll for dipping in the savory butter sauce. Dark rustic table, warm dining lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Lẩu cá kèo lá giang
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Mekong Delta Mudskipper Fish Hotpot with Giang Leaves (Lẩu cá kèo lá giang). A central bubbling hotpot with clear, aromatic, tangy-sour broth simmered with crushed fresh lá giang leaves, tomatoes, and fried shallots. Slices of tender, sweet river mudskipper fish (cá kèo) simmering in the pot, served with a large platter of fresh rau đắng (bitter herb), banana flower shreds, water spinach, and soft rice vermicelli. Small ceramic bowl of pure fish sauce with bird's eye chilies. Dark wooden table, rising steam, 8k resolution.
